public.text: Civil-registration events are described as triggering updates in the Client and Workforce Registries. A birth or death event may require verification, matching, legal finalisation, and domain-specific action rather than automatic record modification.
public.suggestedRevision: Require event validation, identity matching, effective-date management, provenance, confirmation, reconciliation, and exception handling before authoritative records are updated.
